mission: Determine whether the M3R parent/child functional split is linearly recoverable from the frozen query representation, from write/effect geometry, or from neither, without retraining Native CLM or reusing consumed formal seeds as new evidence.
diagnostic_unit: Each spawned lineage child edge parent->child in each canonical M3R lineage-growth checkpoint. Samples are conditioned on reaching that edge's root/ancestor path before the parent-vs-child decision.

registered_features.current_cosine_margin: scalar q dot k_child minus q dot k_parent, evaluated with the M3R rule's fixed direction
registered_features.write_input: Cell operator input x at the Cellular Layer
registered_features.write_left: downstream loss gradient dL/dh_cell_out with the Cellular Layer output detached and treated as the differentiable boundary
registered_features.write_pair: concatenation of L2-normalized write_input and write_left; diagnostic proxy for the rank-1 local write gradient factors
registered_features.certificate_residual: parent Cell input residual x - Q^T Q x under the final parent certificate basis

classification_rules.QUERY_GEOMETRY_SEPARABLE: query median AUC >= separable_median_auc and fraction of valid edges with query AUC >= separable_edge_auc_floor >= minimum_fraction_edges_above_floor
classification_rules.WRITE_EFFECT_GEOMETRY_SEPARABLE: query rule fails, and at least one of write_left/write_pair/certificate_residual satisfies the same separability rule
classification_rules.NO_CLEAR_LOCAL_BOUNDARY: coverage is sufficient but neither query nor registered write/effect features satisfy the separability rule

interpretation_boundary: This is a checkpoint-only diagnostic classification, not a new continual-learning success/failure claim. It may select the architecture family for the next registered experiment, but it may not retroactively alter M3R thresholds or its NOT_SUPPORTED decision.
